fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami-area civic and political affairs, including scrutiny of Florida Power & Light Company franchises and utility rates, the use of public funds and banking practices, and calls for investigation and enforcement in the Fred Osius traffic-death case (including discussion of a blue Marmon car and coroner’s inquest). Coverage also addresses conditions and governance at Jackson Memorial Hospital and the firing of Dr. Lowry, debates over airport location (Dinner Key versus Chapman Field), unfinished street and causeway improvements, and local Miami Beach matters. The issue contains local news flashes (including Tamiami Trail oil-well drilling and Hialeah ex-postmaster Randall), sports/boxing promotion, and extensive bank condition statements and advertisements.
